rows.Compound: 100% carbon-black compound, stiffer in the footprint than the Mid Soft
rows.Tread: Five rows; double-chamfered knob bases (CKB); rear can be reversed
rows.Sizes: 21 inch fronts, 18 inch rears and more. Ask us for yours

metzeler-mce-6-days-extreme.syn: Metzeler's FIM-approved flagship enduro tire, with many world titles and factory fitment on Husqvarna enduro bikes. Built to cope with everything from deep soft ground to rough hardpack.

rows.Best for: Enduro racers and hard trail riders on mixed terrain
rows.Construction: High-strength polyester carcass, stiffer and better damped than before
rows.Compound: Carbon-black reinforced; offered in Hard and Soft versions
rows.Tread: V-shaped front blocks shed mud; alternating rear center blocks
rows.Terrain: Mixed: very soft to hard and rough
rows.Sizes: 21 inch fronts, 18 inch rears. Ask us for yours

pirelli-night-dragon-gt.syn: The longer-lasting version of Pirelli's Night Dragon cruiser tire. It keeps the original's tread and profile but uses a tougher carcass and new rubber for about 20% more miles.

rows.Best for: Touring bikes, cruisers and customs, solo or two-up
rows.Construction: Bias in most sizes, radial in one rear; aramid breakers, higher belt tension
rows.Compound: Full carbon-black compound blending several heat-reactive polymers
rows.Tread: Same pattern as the Night Dragon, with grooves that clear water from the crown
rows.Mileage: About 20% more mileage than the original Night Dragon
rows.Speed rating: H (up to 130 mph) on most sizes; V on the 200/55R17 rear
rows.Sizes: 15 to 17 inch cruiser sizes, front & rear. Ask us for yours

pirelli-diablo-powercruiser.syn: The first cruiser tire in Pirelli's sporty Diablo family, made for performance baggers and power cruisers. A pointier profile and sportbike-style tread let heavy bikes lean and turn more eagerly.

rows.Best for: Performance baggers, club-style bikes, sport cruisers and power cruisers
rows.Construction: Radial with a 0-degree steel belt, or bias, depending on size
rows.Compound: High-silica front; dual-compound rear radials: grippy edges, harder center
rows.Tread: Flash lightning-bolt center for wear and water drainage; slick shoulders
rows.Sizes: 16 to 21 inch fronts, 16 to 18 inch rears up to 260 wide. Ask us for yours

pirelli-mt-route-66.syn: A long-running, value-priced cruiser tire with a classic look. Built for metric cruisers and older bikes, it steers easily, rides comfortably and is known for solid tread life.

rows.Best for: Metric cruisers of all sizes and older or classic bikes
rows.Construction: Bias-ply (nylon), not radial
rows.Sizes: 15 to 21 inch cruiser fronts & rears. Ask us for yours

pirelli-angel-gt.syn: Pirelli's sport-touring radial that replaced the Angel ST, built first and foremost for mileage. A stiffer casing and silica-rich rubber keep it steady loaded two-up and grippy in the wet.

rows.Best for: Sport-tourers, nakeds and road-going ADV bikes, commuting to long trips
rows.Construction: Radial with a stiffer rayon casing than the Angel ST
rows.Compound: 100% silica front; dual-compound rear: silica-rich center, 100% silica edges
rows.Tread: Pattern laid out for even wear and water drainage; wider contact patch
rows.Mileage: Pirelli claims about 30% more mileage than the Angel ST
rows.Speed rating: ZR sizes (rated above 149 mph)
rows.Sizes: 17 and 18 inch fronts & rears for most sport-tourers. Ask us for yours

pirelli-angel-gt-ii.syn: The second-generation Angel GT, aimed at even longer life and better wet grip than the original. Its tread borrows from Pirelli's Superbike rain tires, and there's a version for heavy bikes.

rows.Best for: Sport-tourers, crossovers, ADV road riders and naked bikes
rows.Construction: Radial, steel cord wound tighter at the shoulders; 2-ply heavy-bike version
rows.Compound: High-silica; dual-compound rear with 100% silica shoulders
rows.Tread: Pattern derived from Pirelli's World Superbike rain and intermediate tires
rows.Speed rating: ZR sizes (rated above 149 mph) on most sizes
rows.Sizes: 17 and 19 inch fronts, 17 inch rears for most sport-tourers. Ask us for yours

pirelli-diablo-rosso-4.syn: The fourth-generation Diablo Rosso, Pirelli's Superbike-derived street sport tire. Each size is tuned for the bikes that run it, aiming for more miles and better wet grip than the Rosso III.

rows.Best for: Supersports, hypernakeds and sporty crossovers on the street
rows.Construction: Radial, 0-degree steel belt; Lyocell casing in big rears, rayon elsewhere
rows.Compound: Dual-compound front; rear dual or tri-compound by size, high silica
rows.Tread: Flash lightning-bolt grooves for water and even wear; race-style profile
rows.Speed rating: ZR sizes (rated above 149 mph); a couple of small sizes H
rows.Sizes: 17 inch sport sizes, 110 to 120 front, 140 to 200 rear. Ask us for yours

pirelli-diablo-rosso-4-corsa.syn: The sportiest Diablo Rosso, sitting between the Rosso IV and the Supercorsa. Softer rubber and a slicker tread add dry grip for fast road riding and track days, trading away some tread life.

rows.Best for: Sportbikes and hypernakeds, fast street riding and track days
rows.Construction: Radial, with a reworked casing for more feedback
rows.Compound: Dual compound front & rear: full-silica front, race carbon-black rear
rows.Tread: Slicker than the Rosso IV for a bigger footprint; less wet-weather siping
rows.Speed rating: ZR sizes (rated above 149 mph)
rows.Sizes: 17 inch sport sizes, 110/70 and 120/70 front, 150 to 200 rear. Ask us

pirelli-diablo-supercorsa-v4-sp.syn: A street-legal, race-derived tire for fast road riding and track days, fitted stock on many superbikes. It warms up quickly without tire warmers and works at road or track pressures.

rows.Best for: Superbikes and super nakeds, aggressive street riding and track days
rows.Construction: Radial, Superbike-derived; same profile as the Supercorsa SC race tire
rows.Compound: Dual compound: silica center strip up front, SC3 race rubber on the edges
rows.Tread: Fewer grooves for more rubber at lean; fully slick shoulders
rows.Sizes: 17 inch sport sizes, 110/70 and 120/70 front, 140 to 200 rear. Ask us

pirelli-scorpion-trail-iii.syn: A road-focused adventure tire with sport-touring roots, for ADV and crossover bikes that live on pavement but take the odd gravel road. It puts more rubber down than the Trail II for grip.

rows.Best for: Adventure and crossover bikes ridden mostly on pavement
rows.Construction: Radial with a 0-degree steel belt in most sizes; a few bias sizes
rows.Compound: 100% silica in radial sizes; dual-compound rear: grippy edges, hard center
rows.Tread: Evolved Trail II pattern with Diablo-style grooves; more rubber on the road
rows.Sizes: 17, 18, 19 and 21 inch fronts, 17 and 18 inch rears. Ask us for yours

pirelli-scorpion-rally-str.syn: A knobby-look adventure tire that blends rally-tire bite with street manners. Big center blocks keep it stable on pavement, while open spacing between knobs grips dirt roads.

rows.Best for: ADV, dual-sport and scrambler bikes that mix highway and dirt
rows.Construction: Radial with rayon cords and a variable-density 0-degree steel belt
rows.Compound: Single high-silica compound (about 55% silica) front & rear
rows.Tread: True knobby pattern; large center knobs for road grip, wide gaps for dirt
rows.Sizes: 17, 19 and 21 inch fronts and common ADV rears. Ask us for yours

shinko-777-cruiser-hd.syn: Shinko's best-known cruiser tire in its Heavy Duty build, with a reinforced carcass for big V-twins. A budget-friendly pick that feels planted and handles wet roads well, in black or whitewall.

rows.Best for: Heavy V-twin cruisers and baggers, Harley and metric, on a budget
rows.Construction: Bias with aramid belts; HD version adds a reinforced carcass for load
rows.Tread: Deep diagonal grooves and siping to clear water in the wet
rows.Speed rating: H (up to 130 mph) on most sizes
rows.Sizes: Over 30 front & rear cruiser sizes, 16 to 21 inch, black or white. Ask us for yours

shinko-sr-999-long-haul.syn: Shinko's high-mileage tire for loaded-up V-twin cruisers and tourers. A reinforced, aramid-belted casing carries weight, and the newer rubber is aimed at long tread life with grip in wet or dry.

rows.Best for: Heavy V-twin cruisers and touring bikes that cover big miles
rows.Construction: Reinforced carcass with aramid belting for load capacity
rows.Compound: Newly developed compound aimed at high mileage and grip
rows.Tread: Alternating diagonal rain grooves that move water out fast
rows.Speed rating: H (up to 130 mph); V on the 120/70-21 front
rows.Sizes: About 20 front & rear cruiser sizes, 15 to 21 inch. Ask us for yours

shinko-se890-journey.syn: A radial touring tire for larger touring bikes and cruisers. An aramid-belted radial casing gives a smooth ride and carries weight well, and the all-weather tread is built to clear water.

rows.Best for: Larger touring bikes and cruisers that want a radial ride
rows.Construction: Radial with an aramid belt; tubeless
rows.Compound: Compound designed to balance grip and mileage
rows.Tread: All-weather pattern shaped to disperse water in the rain
rows.Speed rating: H (up to 130 mph)
rows.Sizes: 17 and 18 inch fronts, 16 inch rears up to 200 wide. Ask us for yours

shinko-712.syn: A low-cost bias-ply tire for older metric cruisers, UJMs and classic bikes. Grips surprisingly well in the rain and gives fair warning before it slides. Not suited to heavy Harley Touring loads.

rows.Best for: 1970s-80s metric cruisers, UJMs, older BMWs and classic standards
rows.Construction: Bias-ply, tubeless; firm sidewall that holds up under hard braking
rows.Compound: Softer rubber for grip; the rear can wear faster as a result
rows.Tread: Staggered pattern with aggressive side tread for wet traction
rows.Speed rating: H (up to 130 mph)
rows.Sizes: Classic front & rear sizes, 15 to 19 inch. Ask us for yours

shinko-017-peak.syn: Shinko's newest sport radial, meant to be one tire for everything from long trips to fast canyon days and track time. A three-layer compound warms up quickly at the edges and stays stable down the middle.

rows.Best for: Sportbikes and sport-tourers, street riding to the odd track day
rows.Construction: Radial, lightweight carcass with a jointless spiral steel belt
rows.Compound: 3-layer: durable center for stability, silica-rich shoulders for grip
rows.Tread: Angled center groove for stability; diagonal shoulder grooves for corners
rows.Speed rating: ZR, W rated (up to 168 mph); V on the 200/55R18 rear
rows.Sizes: 17 and 18 inch sport fronts & rears, 160 to 200 rear. Ask us for yours

shinko-016-verge-2x.syn: A dual-compound sport radial with a soft, sticky edge for deep lean angles and quick side-to-side transitions. Strong in the wet for its price, but it trades away tread life to get there.

rows.Best for: Sportbike riders who want strong grip on a budget
rows.Construction: Radial with zero-degree jointless steel belts (JLSB)
rows.Compound: Dual compound: longer-wearing center, softer stickier shoulders
rows.Tread: Siped pattern for wet grip; profile built for quick, deep leans
rows.Speed rating: ZR, W rated (up to 168 mph)
rows.Sizes: 17 inch only: 120/60 and 120/70 fronts, 160 to 200 rears. Ask us for yours

shinko-230-tour-master.syn: A budget bias-ply touring tire built to carry heavy loads over long distances, in wet or dry weather. The staggered tread keeps the ride quiet, and many sizes are rated for high speed.

rows.Best for: Standards, tourers and metric cruisers covering long, loaded miles
rows.Construction: Bias-ply with aramid belts; tubeless
rows.Tread: Staggered pattern for a quiet ride and steady handling, wet or dry
rows.Speed rating: V (up to 149 mph) on most sizes; some H
rows.Sizes: Wide range of 15 to 21 inch fronts & rears. Ask us for yours

shinko-010-apex-radial.syn: Shinko's hypersport radial for high-performance sportbikes. The tread is tuned for high-speed cornering, with a steel-belted rear for stability and an aramid-belted front.

rows.Best for: High-performance sportbikes and fast street riding
rows.Construction: Radial: zero-degree jointless steel belt rear, aramid-belted front
rows.Tread: Pattern designed for stability in high-speed corners
rows.Speed rating: ZR, W rated (up to 168 mph) on rears
rows.Sizes: 17 inch sport sizes, 120/60 and 120/70 fronts, 150 to 200 rears. Ask us

shinko-705-dual-sport.syn: A street-leaning dual-sport tire, rated about 80% pavement and 20% dirt. Smooth and quiet on the highway and confident in the rain, with big blocks that handle fire roads and light trails.

rows.Best for: ADV, dual-sport and standard bikes that mostly ride pavement
rows.Construction: Radial or bias, depending on size
rows.Tread: Large, directional tread blocks; quiet at highway speed
rows.Mileage: Reviewers got about 5,000 to 8,000 miles from a rear; fronts last ~twice as long
rows.Speed rating: H (up to 130 mph) on most sizes; a few Q, P or V
rows.Sizes: 17, 18, 19 and 21 inch fronts & rears, tube and tubeless. Ask us for yours

shinko-e804-805-adventure-trail.syn: A big-block adventure tire for full-size ADV bikes that spend most of their time off pavement, about 40% road and 60% dirt. Stable on soft ground, yet still comfortable on the highway.

rows.Best for: Full-size ADV bikes that ride mostly off-road
rows.Construction: Heavy-duty carcass with stable sidewalls; bias or radial by size
rows.Tread: Classic big-block knobs; mud and snow (M+S) rated
rows.Sizes: 19 and 21 inch fronts (E804), 16 to 18 inch rears (E805). Ask us for yours

shinko-504-505-off-road.syn: An off-road pair for hard-pack, rocks and roots. The standard 504/505 uses firm, long-wearing rubber; the 505 Cheater rear swaps in soft, trials-style rubber for big grip on climbs and technical trails.

rows.Best for: Trail and hard-enduro riders on rocky, hard-packed ground
rows.Compound: Standard: firm and durable. Cheater rear: soft, sticky trials-style rubber
rows.Tread: Closely spaced knobs with crisp edges; side knobs bite in corners
rows.Terrain: Intermediate to hard: hard-pack, rocks and roots (not deep sand)
rows.Sizes: 21 inch front (504); 18 and 19 inch rears (505 and Cheater). Ask us for yours

shinko-524-525-off-road.syn: A soft-to-intermediate off-road pair for sand, loam and mud. Wider-spaced knobs clean out and dig in, and the softer rubber rides comfortably, though it wears quicker than Shinko's harder-terrain tires.

rows.Best for: MX and trail riders on sand, loam, mud and soft dirt
rows.Compound: Softer, more pliable rubber than the 504/505
rows.Tread: Deep, wide-spaced self-cleaning knobs, reinforced against chunking
rows.Terrain: Soft to intermediate; can feel squirmy on hard pack and rocks
rows.Sizes: Fronts (524) and rears (525) from 14 inch minis to full-size. Ask us for yours
